entries.title: Pad Your Stats

requirements.name_normalized: mazzo tradizionale con joker per spareggio
requirements.name_raw: Preparation: In a 3 player game, remove Jokers, all 2-6's, and red 7's; this leaves 30 cards. In a 4 player game, remove Jokers and 2-4's; this leaves 40 cards. In a 5 player game, remove Jokers and red 2's; this leaves 50 cards.
